Upstream license status
=======================

Source:
BigStationW/ComfyUi-Untwisting-RoPE
https://github.com/BigStationW/ComfyUi-Untwisting-RoPE

Vendored subset:
- __init__.py
- runtime.py, adapted from upstream __init__.py
- rf_inversion.py
- sdpa_fix.py
- verbose_prints.py
- models/*.py

Important:
The upstream pyproject.toml declares `license = {file = "LICENSE"}`, but the
local upstream checkout used for this vendor import does not contain a LICENSE
file. The GitHub raw LICENSE URL also returned 404 when checked on 2026-06-10.

Do not publish this vendored runtime as licensed third-party code until the
upstream project adds a license file or the author grants explicit permission.
